details:
The VRChat does not really limit amount of objects that single user can pickup in same time and objects on big amount of maps (that have pickup-able objects) have the collisions with each other enabled, so it can be used by the (custom/cheat) client users that have ability to pickup a lot of objects in same time and cause the lag or crash the entire instance. 

The example case: 

Player with client logged into the instance, his Limb ID was set to the 147

2025.02.28 23:52:42 Debug      -  [Behaviour] Initialize Limb Avatar VRCPlayer[Remote] 147 False 5

2025.02.28 23:52:42 Debug      -  [Behaviour] Will use Job system for Avatar on VRCPlayer[Remote] 71194331 147

2025.02.28 23:52:42 Debug      -  [Behaviour] Initialized PlayerAPI "112ヅ" is remote

He activated his custom client and most of the object owner status on the map got transferred to his Limb ID - 147:

2025.02.28 23:52:56 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of Stage Microphone to 147

2025.02.28 23:52:56 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Received ownership transfer of 250 from 147 to 147

2025.02.28 23:52:56 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of Knife (1) to 147

2025.02.28 23:52:56 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Received ownership transfer of 251 from 147 to 147

2025.02.28 23:52:56 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of Knife (2) to 147

2025.02.28 23:52:56 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Received ownership transfer of 276 from 147 to 147

2025.02.28 23:52:56 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of MBoard Menu R01 to 147

The user got banned from the instance and objects owner status got reset to 0 (map default):

2025.02.28 23:54:03 Debug      -  [Behaviour] OnPlayerLeft 112ヅ (usr_b057939b-acc5-41d7-9ec9-58a147e3b9cb)

2025.02.28 23:54:03 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of DJ Microphone to 0

2025.02.28 23:54:03 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of Manager Microphone to 0

2025.02.28 23:54:03 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of Security Microphone to 0

2025.02.28 23:54:03 Debug      -  [NetworkProcessing] Transferred ownership of Stage Microphone to 0

The "full" logs are in attachments.

The only fix is to limit amount of objects that can be held by single person at same time and enforce ban on crashers/client users. And map creator should disable objects collision with each other.
